statements.t: OFG aims to deliver intelligent growth, operational excellence, and deeper financial empowerment to make progress possible for our communities.

The preparation of financial statements in accordance with GAAP requires management to make judgments, assumptions and estimates that affect the reported amount of assets, liabilities, income and expenses in the consolidated financial statements.
OFG measures its ACL based on management’s best estimate of expected credit losses inherent in OFG’s relevant financial assets.

estimates.name: FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS
estimates.t: With year-over-year increases of 14.7% in EPS, 9.2% in net income and 1.0% in core revenues, third quarter results reflected continued momentum in commercial loan growth, stable credit quality and core deposit balances, disciplined expense management, and healthy profitability.
